originality.rationale: The originated free quadric quotient and its rational b2 are established prior results, as are the Cartan–Leray and equivariant projective-bundle ingredients and canonical order two. The exact full truncated integral ring and independent order-two monomial classes in each sub-middle even degree, including all canonical cup powers, are not implied as stated by the original Betti-number calculation or the different hyper-Kähler Brauer studies. Three actual published-finding corpus query families, six direct web searches, primary-text comparisons, and six own-ledger claims were checked. This is a best-knowledge priority judgment, not a uniqueness proof.

value.rationale: A complete below-middle integral cohomology ring of a natural infinite family of Enriques manifolds gives j independent 2-torsion classes in H^{2j} and canonical torsion powers t^j surviving for all j<m, with unbounded length across dimensions. This is a deformation-stable structural invariant missed by every rational Betti number and much stronger than the known single canonical 2-torsion class. The middle-degree exclusion marks a nontrivial exact geometric boundary.
